name: Creavit Studio
soft_passes: #4 16px squint: dark card survives but the divider + side rails (the entire identity) smear to a generic charcoal-on-gold blob at Dock/Spotlight size
#5 single light model: consistent only because wholly flat — no modeled light
#8 depth coherence: no z-fighting but no depth at all; strict squircle format implies Big Sur baked lighting the art never delivers
#10 variant robustness: not authored as glass layers, but shape-driven two-tone would survive dark/tinted trivially
failures: #3 silhouette/subject: filled solid, reads as an abstract framed panel with a slit and two side tabs — not instantly nameable and communicates nothing about video/screen recording
light_model: Flat / none — no cast shadow, no baked micro-shadow, no specular; two-tone graphic, system supplies the external drop shadow only
devices: bisecting white seam splitting the dark panel and running past its ends into the field
twin charcoal side capsule rails (grips/device-buttons) in the margins
monochrome charcoal+white mark on a single saturated brand field
rhymes_hint: flat monochrome-abstract-mark-on-one-saturated-brand-field utility icons (charcoal/white glyph on a bright hue); indie-utility flat-squircle family — NOT the diagonal-tool Big Sur family and NOT Liquid Glass specular
notes: 512x512 resized web export (half the 1024 master); no @2x seen so fine specular/shadow indistinguishable from resize flattening, but unambiguously no glass and no baked depth — a genuinely flat two-tone design, not a downsampled Liquid Glass icon. Background is flat #F2BF00; the #FCC700 at the mask edge is anti-alias, not a ramp. Mask is pre-baked (transparent corners). Cover hero shows the same icon rendered in 3D with an electric-BLUE inner panel where the shipped icon uses charcoal — brand intent appears gold+blue, but shipped icon.png is gold+charcoal+white only (accent-blue present in cover, absent from icon; partial palette coherence). White seam extends beyond the card (y37-473 vs card y58-452), reading as a stand/seam not an inset stripe; sits ~4px right of true center at 512 (negligible).
